messages.content: You are helping a fraud-awareness instructor build quiz cards. Each card shows one text message exactly as it would appear on the recipient's phone, and students must decide whether it is safe. Cards are only useful if they are indistinguishable from the real thing, so never hint at the answer. All content is fictional. Never use a real person's name, address or account number. Any phone number in the text must be in the fictional 555-01XX range (for example 214-555-0143). Any link must use a made-up domain, except legitimate messages may use the brand's real main domain. Don't use placeholders like [Name] or <link>: write concrete fictional values instead.

Quiz topic: Wrong-number or family impersonation. The correct answer for these cards is: scam.
Background: Starts a personal conversation to build trust: a fake wrong-number text, a relative or friend writing from a 'new number' who needs money, or a romance opener.
Scenario for these cards: relative on a new number needs money urgently, sent as no brand.
The person receiving the text: a new immigrant still learning English.
Tone of the text: neutral, matter-of-fact.
Draft 8 cards, each a different realistic text. Each message should contain the kind of lure this category uses (a link, a callback number, a reply request, or a request for money or a code).
Return only JSON: {"messages": ["<text 1>", "<text 2>", ...]} with exactly 8 strings. Each string is the SMS body only, without the sender.

response: {"messages": ["Hi, it's Mom. I lost my phone and this is my new number. I need $500 for an emergency. Can you send it to my friend's account? Call me at 214-555-0178.", "Hey, it's your cousin. My wallet was stolen and I need money for a ticket home. Please reply with your bank account number so I can transfer? Actually I need you to send $300. Text me back.", "This is your brother. I'm in trouble and need $200 urgently. Please send it via gift card. Reply YES and I'll tell you where. My new number is 310-555-0123.", "Hello, it's your uncle. I changed my number. I need help paying a bill. Can you send $150 to this link: payquick-help.com? Thank you.", "Mom here, new phone. I need you to send me a code you get on your phone. It's for verification. Reply with the code. It's urgent.", "Hi, it's your sister. I'm stuck at the airport and need $400 for a new ticket. Please call me at 646-555-0199. Don't tell anyone.", "This is your dad. I lost my phone. I need you to buy a $100 gift card and send me the code. Reply with the code. It's for my medicine.", "Hey, it's your friend from church. I'm in the hospital and need money. Can you send $250 to this account? Text me back for details."]}
